Meet Sophisti-Cuts

Sophisti-Cuts: Bold color, classic cuts

Sophisti-Cuts is a hair salon on Pitney Street in Sayre, PA. The work runs from balayage and blonde services to classic cuts.

The service list covers balayage refresh and caramel balayage, soft highlights, highlights and lowlights, champagne blonde, haircuts, extensions, and spray tan. Appointments are booked by phone.
